name: diversity-p2
description:
Diversity test at ply 2 (11-12 ~01:05: the user approved the analyst's plan; theory-2 6.45 (2), 6.51, 6.53). 6.51's diagnosis: weaker play is shallower play's blunder structure, and own-field replay (replay-p2, closed) pulled the value function toward ply-1 play; coverage must come from OTHER players above a quality floor.
- Design: probit-late-p2's lines (F-P x2; T-P-Ne (NB error router, non-merging, limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03) x2), seed 48 (new), plus four frozen external references at ply 2 (frozen_references): error-routing-p1's v314 finals F-P#1, F-P#2 and the two T-P-Ne lines (P2x, models/from-scratch/offline-ply/players-P2x.txt) as xFP1, xFP2, xTNe1, xTNe2. They play every round-robin; they never train, are never crowned or retired, play no self-games and stay out of the plateau rule; their own calibration is recreated as error-routing-p1 made it (its settings and hybrid13, checked against its records). All three kinds of game train the lines (line-line, line-reference, reference-reference), logged each cycle (totals.csv local_*, the report's Local set line).
- One factor against probit-late-p2: the four frozen references in the field (and so the larger batch).
- At 12 rounds the field is 12 entries (8 line entries, current + champion, plus 4 references): 1,584 games a cycle. Line-line 672, equal to probit-late-p2's whole round-robin volume; line-ref 768 and ref-ref 144. The batch equals base-probit-p2's.
- Comparators: base-probit-p2's F-P at equal versions (equal batch; that field also held DAG and cluster-tree lines); probit-late-p2 at equal positions (diversity v169 = pure v399) and at equal versions.
- Predictions (analyst 6.53, head to head, ply 2): over base-probit-p2's F-P at v300 and v599: 100-200; over probit-late-p2's F-P at equal positions: 60-150, at v300: 120-220; tree over its flat inside diversity at v300: 0-50; ply 1: 0-40; ply 3 within 40.
- The null that matters: within 30 of base-probit-p2's F-P at equal batch. That would send the next league back to ply 1.
- ply-2 field (entry_ply 2, no ply-1 entries, no random references), self-games (lines only), hybrid16 games, prices P2; scaled plateau from 300 cycles, cap 400. After create, leagues/specs/ply1/train_binary.py moves training to hybrid6 (exact).
- Read: cold at plies 1-3 (T 0.02, 75 round-robins), pooled head to heads (h2h_btg.py) against the comparators.
